**Direction: Complete the sentence by choosing the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.**

When you __**look** __at something you ______ it.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"see."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"See"** means to perceive or notice something with your eyes. (देखना, नेत्रों द्वारा प्रत्‍यक्ष करना; दृष्टि-शक्ति का प्रयोग करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *On a clear day you can **see**__ for miles.*
 
 
 
• It is the most appropriate synonym for **"look at"** in this sentence.
 
• **"Look" **means to turn your eyes in a particular direction (in order to pay attention to somebody/something). ((किसी व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु को ध्यान से) देखना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *Sorry, I wasn’t **looking**__. Can you show me again?*
 
 

The correct answer is** Option 2.**

**Correct sentence**: *When you look at something you __**see**__ it.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **"Hear"** means to perceive sound with your ears. (सुनना)
 
• **"Ignore"** means to pay no attention to something. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु पर कोई ध्यान न देना, की उपेक्षा करना)
 
• **"Touch" **means to come into contact with something with your hand or another part of your body. ((किसी को) छूना, स्‍पर्श करना)

questions.question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in past perfect tense.**

A. I read a lot about mythology.

B. I had been reading a lot about mythology.

C. I was reading a lot about mythology.

D. I had read a lot about mythology.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **"****D."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Past perfect tense** is used to describe an action that was completed before another action in the past.
 
• The structure of past perfect tense is** "had + past participle."**
 
 
• **Example: ***She had done her homework.*
 
 
 
• In this sentence, the action of **"reading a lot about mythology" **happened before another past action that is not mentioned in the sentence.
 
• The past perfect tense is formed by using **"had"** as an auxiliary verb and the past participle form of the main verb** "read."**

The correct answer is **Option 2.**

**Correct sentence**:* **I had read a lot about mythology.*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option A, "I read a lot about mythology,"** is in simple past tense and does not convey the idea of an action completed before another past action.
 
• Option B, **"****I had been reading a lot about mythology,"** is in past perfect continuous tense.
 
• **Option C, "I was reading a lot about mythology,"** is in past continuous tense and does not convey the idea of an action completed before another past action.
